name: Kaede Doori - Brand new days innocent-
source:
Main character studies at a university and works at a part-time job. It is possible to seek love from heroines of "Days Innocent" who have grown up, or from new girls. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]

主角在大學學習並從事兼職工作。可以向《純真的時光》中已長大的女主角或新來的女孩尋求愛情。
